brief: a reel about Goa in the monsoon for our travel page

context.audience: young Indian travellers who think Goa is only for winter

concept: Goa in the rain is a different, greener secret: the season nobody posts.
plan_outline: 1. MCU · eye · handheld · scooter on a coastal road, rain · a girl on a scooter pillion, arms out in the rain, laughing (2 s, the hook)
2. EWS · high · crane · paddy fields and a white church · emerald green under heavy grey clouds (3 s)
3. CU · eye · static · roadside shack · rain dripping from a tin roof into puddles, chai steaming below (2 s)
4. WS · eye · track · empty beach, storm light · waves crashing, a lone dog running along the shore (3 s)
5. MS · eye · static · old Portuguese house veranda · two friends playing cards as rain pours off the eaves (3 s)
why: The concept is a reversal of expectation, which is itself a hook for travellers.
Energy comes from cutting every 2–3 s; each shot is one clear motion the model can render.
A consistent palette (saturated greens, grey skies, warm practicals) makes 5 places feel like one film.
Crowds avoided: two people at most per frame.
